# shopify_metaobject_definition (Data Source)

Reads a metaobject definition and its fields by type. Use it for definitions owned by Shopify (`shopify--…`) or by an app, which can't be imported into `shopify_metaobject_definition`; it works for merchant-owned definitions too. Fails if no such definition exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A definition owned by Shopify, which can't be imported into a resource.
data "shopify_metaobject_definition" "material" {
  type = "shopify--material"
}

output "material_fields" {
  value = [for f in data.shopify_metaobject_definition.material.field : f.key]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Definition type, e.g. `shopify--material`, exactly as the API returns it.

### Read-Only

- `access` (Attributes) API access settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access))
- `capabilities` (Attributes) Capabilities of entries of this type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `description` (String) Description. Empty when none is set.
- `display_name_key` (String) Key of the field used as display name for entries. Empty when none is set.
- `field` (Attributes List) Field definitions, in display order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--field))
- `id` (String) Metaobject definition GID.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name.

<a id="nestedatt--access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access`

Read-Only:

- `admin` (String) Admin API access. Null when Shopify reports a value that `shopify_metaobject_definition` can't set, e.g. the default `PUBLIC_READ_WRITE`.
- `customer_account` (String) Customer account API access.
- `storefront` (String) Storefront API access.


<a id="nestedatt--capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `capabilities`

Read-Only:

- `publishable` (Boolean) Entries have a draft/active status.
- `renderable` (Boolean) Entries can be rendered as web pages (SEO data).
- `translatable` (Boolean) Entries can be translated.


<a id="nestedatt--field"></a>
### Nested Schema for `field`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description. Null when none is set.
- `key` (String) Field key.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether entries must set this field.
- `type` (String) Field type, e.g. `single_line_text_field`.
- `validations` (Map of String) Validation name to value. Null when none is set.
